essence: Unreal orders arise by delusion; shining-things darkness takes non-self for self, burst upon burst; self nets itself spider-like; unwrapped, supreme Śiva spreads bondage-release play; states shine in the fourth unveiled; three states told, fourth beyond; sky unsoiled, jars unsoiled.

sections.SUMMARY: So dharma through pain, caste through stations, though unreal in the self, arise by delusion's force. This is that darkness: shining in things, the not-self is taken for self — darkness upon darkness, a burst upon the cheek, body and breath taken for self. By body-breath-reflection yoga the self wraps itself in a net like the net-maker; unwrapped by its own shining glory, supreme Śiva spreads the play of bondage and release. Creating, waking, sleep shine in the fourth, yet unveiled. Waking is difference-universe, dreaming is light-glory, sleep is massed knowing — beyond, the fourth. As sky unsoiled by cloud-smoke-dust, the person untouched by Māyā; as one dusty jar leaves others clean, souls enjoy differences unstained.

rasa.dominant: karuṇa-śānta of bondage shown and dissolved
rasa.justification: Darkness pitied, unwrapping stillness: net shown, play spread, gold seen.
